scenario: Original Composer real CLI long turn, queued next turn, edit queued draft, automatic promotion, then idle /compact
uiObserved: While the first real CLI turn displayed numbered output and Stop, the original Composer offered Add to queue; the next text appeared in the queue with Edit, Send now and Remove controls.
Edit returned the queued text to the original Composer. After changing its marker and submitting again, the new queue item appeared while the first turn was still streaming.

The first turn completed with QUEUE_FIRST_DONE_6BC. The revised queued turn then ran automatically and replied QUEUE_SECOND_EDITED_DONE_6BC. The superseded marker QUEUE_SECOND_DONE_6BC was not executed.
Idle /compact appeared in the original slash picker, disabled Composer controls while running, then returned the Composer to Send.
limits: This proves text queue edit/cancel/promotion and idle compaction only. Queued attachments and busy compaction remain implementation gaps.
